methods.name: fire
methods.body: const claw=field.claw;if(!claw.alive)return;let want=false;if(!this.playing){let near=claw.dropping?1:0;const lanes=[...field.enemyShots.map(s=>s.inPlay?s.lane:-1),...field.enemies.map(e=>e.inPlay?e.lane:-1)];for(const l of lanes)if(l>=0&&Math.abs(l-claw.lane)<2)near=near+1;want=near!=0}else want=this.fireHeld;if(!want)return;for(let i=7;i>=0;i--){const s=field.shots[i];if(s.inPlay)continue;this.shotsFlying=this.shotsFlying+1;this.sound("fire");field.shots[i]={id:i,inPlay:true,lane:claw.lane,nextLane:claw.lane+1&15,depth:claw.depth,depthFraction:s.depthFraction,spikesHit:0,used:false};this.hitsFor(field,i);return}

methods.name: chooseKind
methods.body: const lv=this.game.level;const allowed={flipper:lv.flippers,pulsar:lv.pulsars,tanker:lv.tankers,spiker:lv.spikers,fuseball:lv.fuseballs};const count=this.game.kindCount;const room=noneOfEach();for(const k of this.kinds)if(allowed[k].max>=count[k])room[k]=allowed[k].max-count[k];for(let i2=lv.enemySlots-1;i2>=0;i2--){const e=field.enemies[i2];if(e.inPlay&&e.cargo!="none"){const k=this.cargoKind(e.cargo);room[k]=(room[k]+254)%256}}const free=(lv.enemySlots-this.kinds.reduce((n,k)=>n+count[k],0)+256)%256;for(const k of this.kinds)if(free<room[k])room[k]=free;const open=this.kinds.filter(k=>room[k]!=0).length;if(open==0)return null;const lastFirst=[...this.kinds].reverse();if(open==1){for(const k of lastFirst){if(room[k]!=0&&allowed[k].min!=0){const l=this.launchOf(k,room,lane);if(l!=null)return l}}return null}for(const k of lastFirst){if(room[k]!=0&&count[k]<allowed[k].min){const l=this.launchOf(k,room,lane);if(l!=null)return l}}if(room.spiker!=0&&room.tanker!=0){const l=this.launchOf(this.spikeTip(field,lane)<204?"tanker":"spiker",room,lane);if(l!=null)return l}let i=(this.game.random(2)&3)+1;let tries=4;do{const k=this.kinds[i];if(allowed[k].min!=0&&room[k]!=0){const l=this.launchOf(k,room,lane);if(l!=null)return l;tries=this.lastTankerTry}i=i==0?4:i-1;tries=tries-1}while(tries>=0);return null

true;if(this.flipStep(field,e)){e.count=4;e.plan="avoid.after"}return false}case"avoid.after":if(this.redirected(e,this.move(field,e)))return true;e.count=byte(e.count-1);if(e.count!=0)return false;e.plan="avoid";return true;case"rim":e.count=4;this.catchAtRim(field,e);e.plan="rim.waiting";return false;case"rim.waiting":e.count=byte(e.count-1);if(e.count!=0){this.catchAtRim(field,e);return false}this.startFlip(field,e);e.plan="rim.flipping";return false;case"rim.flipping":e.count=this.game.level.rimFlipSteps;while(true){if(this.flipStep(field,e)){e.plan="rim";return false;case"fuseball.crossing":e.count=3;this.fuseCatch(field,e);e.plan="fuseball.counting";return false;case"fuseball.counting":e.count=byte(e.count-1);if(e.count!=0){this.fuseCatch(field,e);return false}switch(this.fuseballFlipStep(field,e)){case"landed":e.plan="fuseball";return true;case"chasing":e.plan="fuseball.crossing";return true;case"flipping":e.plan="fuseball.crossing";return false;case"pulsar.waiting":e.count=byte(e.count-1);if(e.count!=0){if(this.redirected(e,this.pulsarMove(field,e)))return true;return false}e.plan="pulsar.watching";return true;case"pulsar.watching":if(this.pulseSoon()){if(this.redirected(e,this.pulsarMove(field,e)))return true;return false}this.headForPlayer(field,e);this.startFlip(field,e);e.plan="pulsar.flipping";return false;case"pulsar.flipping":if(this.flipStep(field,e)){e.plan="pulsar";return true}return false}return false

methods.body: if(this.farGone!=0||this.shows!="play")return[];const s=this.well.shapes[this.well.id];const far=this.rim(FAR),near=this.rim(0);const spokes=this.spokeColors();const out=[];for(let k=15;k>0;k=k-2){const[a,b,c,d]=this.camera.legs([far[k],near[k],near[k-1],far[k-1]],SMALL);out.push({ink:spokes[k],i:12,p:[...a,...b]},{ink:spokes[k-1],i:12,p:[...c,...d]})}const lanes=s.open?15:16;for(const[points,hidden]of this.nearGone==0?[[far,false],[near,true]]:[[far,false]]){const order=[15];for(let n=0;n<lanes;n++)order.push(order[n]+15&15);const at=this.camera.legs(order.map(i=>points[i]),SMALL);let line=[];for(let n=1;n<=lanes;n++){if(hidden&&this.pulsarOn(order[n])){line=[];continue}if(line.length==0){line=[...at[n-1]];out.push({ink:"well",i:12,p:line})}line.push(...at[n])}}return out

methods.body: const marks=new Array(16).fill(0);const v=this.game.value;if(!v.claw.dropping){for(const e of v.enemies.slice(0,this.game.level.enemySlots)){if(!e.inPlay||e.kind!="pulsar")continue;let m=1;if(!e.flipping){if(this.game.pulseOn&&e.depth<this.game.level.pulsarReach)m=3;marks[e.lane+1&15]=marks[e.lane+1&15]|m}marks[e.lane]=marks[e.lane]|m|128}}const plain=this.game.zapTime==0?"well":(this.game.frame&7)==7?"claw":ROLES[this.game.frame&7];const claw=v.claw;return marks.map((m,x)=>{if(m!=0)return m&2?ROLES[this.game.frame&1]:"well";if(claw.depth!=0&&claw.alive&&(x==claw.lane||x==(claw.lane+1&15)))return"claw";if(this.game.flashing)return this.roleAt(x+this.flashFrom&7);return plain})

methods.name: draw
methods.body: const palette=this.$provided("palette");const px=this.$provided("px");const beam=this.$provided("beam");const groups=new Map;for(const t of this.traced){const key=`${t.ink}:${t.i}:${t.p.length==2?1:0}`;const g=groups.get(key);if(g)g.push(t);else groups.set(key,[t])}d.lineCap="round";d.lineJoin="round";d.globalCompositeOperation=beam.additive?"lighter":"source-over";for(const[key,group]of groups){const[ink,bright,dot]=key.split(":");let rgb=palette[ink]??16777215;if(rgb==243)rgb=1981683;const r=rgb>>16&255,g=rgb>>8&255,b=rgb&255;const color=`rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;const lift=v=>v+beam.core*(255-v)|0;const core=`rgb(${lift(r)},${lift(g)},${lift(b)})`;const level=Math.min(1,beam.gain*Number(bright)/15);d.shadowColor=color;if(dot=="1"){const light=beam.gain*Number(bright)*64;const spot=radius=>{d.beginPath();for(const t of group){d.moveTo(t.p[0]+radius,t.p[1]);d.arc(t.p[0],t.p[1],radius,0,6.2832)}};spot(beam.width*(1+2.5*Math.min(1,light/2e3))*px);d.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,2*beam.glow*Math.min(.85,light/1500));d.shadowBlur=8*beam.spread;d.fillStyle=color;d.fill();spot(beam.width*(.8+.8*Math.min(1,light/1e3))*px);d.globalAlpha=1-Math.exp(-light/150);d.shadowBlur=2*beam.spread;d.fillStyle=core;d.fill();continue}d.beginPath();for(const t of group){d.moveTo(t.p[0],t.p[1]);for(let k=2;k<t.p.length;k+=2)d.lineTo(t.p[k],t.p[k+1])}d.strokeStyle=color;if(beam.halo>0){d.globalAlpha=beam.halo*level;d.shadowBlur=beam.spread*(8+10*level);d.lineWidth=beam.width*(3+3*level)*px;d.stroke()}d.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,beam.glow*level*level);d.shadowBlur=beam.spread*(2+4*level);d.lineWidth=beam.width*(1.4+1.6*level)*px;d.stroke();d.globalAlpha=level;d.shadowBlur=.5*level*beam.spread;d.strokeStyle=core;d.lineWidth=beam.width*(.9+.6*level)*px;d.stroke()}

methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";const crossOf=c=>{if(flexing(c))return{lead:0,extent:c[crossSize]};const fc=c.footprint();return{lead:axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x,extent:fc[crossSize]}};let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,crossOf(c).extent);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"){const co=crossOf(c);const leadC=co.lead;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-co.extent)/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-co.extent;else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})
